enriched_activities.desc: Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Stretch arms. Turn onto back.

enriched_activities.activity: Waking up, washing face and brushing teeth
enriched_activities.desc: Wake up. Sit up on bed. Stand up. Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on tap. Pick up toothbrush. Apply toothpaste. Brush teeth. Rinse mouth. Put down toothbrush. Cup hands under water. Splash water on face. Pick up towel. Wipe face. Turn off tap. Turn off light. Walk out of bathroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Preparing and eating breakfast while checking phone
enriched_activities.desc: Open refrigerator. Take out milk and eggs. Close refrigerator. Take out pan. Place pan on stove. Turn on stove. Crack eggs into pan. Stir eggs. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Check messages. Put down phone. Flip eggs. Turn off stove. Transfer eggs to plate. Sit at table. Pick up fork. Eat eggs. Drink milk.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed in work clothes and packing bag for the shift
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Open closet. Take out shirt and pants. Take off pajamas. Put on shirt. Button shirt. Put on pants. Zip pants. Put on socks. Put on shoes. Open drawer. Take out stethoscope and badge. Put items in bag. Zip bag. Pick up bag.

enriched_activities.activity: Commuting to the hospital for work
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Look out window. Check phone. Put phone in pocket. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk to hospital entrance. Push door open. Walk to locker room. Put bag in locker.

enriched_activities.activity: Working as a health care professional: patient care, charting and clinical handover
enriched_activities.desc: Arrive at ward. Wash hands. Visit patient room. Check patient vital signs. Administer medication. Update patient chart. Attend handover meeting. Discuss patient status. Assist with medical procedure. Clean medical equipment. Wash hands. Take lunch break. Return to ward. Check medical supplies. Restock supplies.
Walk to bus stop. Wait for bus. Board bus. Swipe card. Find seat. Sit down. Check phone. Put phone away. Stand up. Pull cord. Exit bus. Walk home. Open door. Walk inside. Close door. Put bag down.

Open refrigerator. Take out vegetables. Close refrigerator. Chop vegetables. Turn on stove. Pour oil in pan. Add vegetables. Stir. Add seasoning. Turn off stove. Transfer to plate. Sit at table. Eat dinner. Drink water.

enriched_activities.activity: Washing dishes and cleaning the counter
enriched_activities.desc: Turn on tap. Pick up sponge. Apply soap. Scrub plate. Rinse plate. Place plate in drying rack. Scrub fork. Rinse fork. Place fork in drying rack. Scrub pan. Rinse pan. Place pan in drying rack. Turn off tap. Pick up cloth. Wipe counter. Rinse cloth. Wring cloth. Hang cloth.

enriched_activities.activity: Relaxing on the sofa watching TV
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to living room. Sit on sofa. Pick up remote. Turn on TV. Change channel. Put down remote. Lean back. Pick up phone. Scroll. Put down phone. Watch TV. Get up. Go to kitchen. Get snack. Return to sofa. Sit down. Eat snack. Watch TV.

enriched_activities.activity: Loading and running the washing machine for laundry
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Open washing machine door. Pick up laundry basket. Sort clothes. Put clothes in washing machine. Close door. Open detergent drawer. Pour detergent. Close drawer. Press start button. Pick up empty basket. Walk out of bathroom. Close bathroom door.

enriched_activities.activity: Wind-down time: using phone and computer, reading
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bedroom. Sit on bed. Pick up phone. Unlock phone. Scroll through social media. Put down phone. Open laptop. Turn on laptop. Check email. Close laptop. Pick up book. Open book. Read. Turn page. Put down book. Pick up phone again.

enriched_activities.activity: Evening personal care and shower before bed
enriched_activities.desc: Walk to bathroom. Turn on light. Turn on shower. Adjust temperature. Take off clothes. Step into shower. Wet body. Apply soap. Scrub body. Rinse body. Turn off shower. Step out. Pick up towel. Dry body. Dry hair. Wrap towel. Walk to bedroom.

Lie down on bed. Pull blanket over body. Close eyes. Breathe slowly. Remain still. Turn to left side. Adjust pillow. Turn to right side. Kick off blanket. Pull blanket back. Stretch arms. Turn onto back.
